summary.en: Iraq's parliament approved the al-Zaidi cabinet while the government continued to detain seven Ukrainians suspected of plotting an attack on Persian Gulf oil facilities. Turkish foreign minister met OIC foreign ministers in Baghdad for the 52nd session, and Iraqi officials hosted multiple diplomatic talks on de-escalation and regional cooperation. The Kurdistan Region reported a more investor-friendly climate in a US report and Italy prepared to resume military training and intelligence cooperation with Kurdish forces. The Pentagon lowered its count of Iran war dead and wounded, prompting questions. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
